mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over 60 trading days signals an easing monetary policy cycle, compressing discount rates on equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 4.0% in the next 3 months triggers a loss of investor confidence, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises > 0.1 percentage points in the next 3 months
failure_condition: UNRATE does not cross above 4.0% in the next 3 months, or 20-day returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent increases in demand (GDPC1) and supply (INDPRO) indices signal a balanced economic expansion, enhancing corporate profitability and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: Both GDPC1 and INDPRO increase in the same month
failure_condition: The correlation between GDPC1 and INDPRO is below 0.5 over the 5-day horizon, or returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a sustained federal funds rate below 2% signals accommodative monetary policy, boosting equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS does not remain below 2% in late-cycle expansion, or 20-day returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Rising demand (GDPC1) and housing-related demand (HOUST) simultaneously indicate robust economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: Both GDPC1 and HOUST increase in the same month
failure_condition: The interaction effect (product of GDPC1 and HOUST) shows no significant positive correlation over the 5-day horizon, or returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the supply index (INDPRO) above 102.5 signals improved business conditions, prompting positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO does not cross above 102.5, or 60-day returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle, a sustained rise in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals higher interest rates, compressing equity valuations and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises > 0.5% in a tightening cycle regime
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS does not rise above 4.5% in the tightening cycle, or 20-day returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the CPIAUCSL inflation index over 60 trading days signals rising inflation expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL does not show a sustained increase over 60 days, or 60-day returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05).
